page.overview:
Who is Adder Ain-la?

Adder Ain-la was a poet famous for his denunciation of the planet Coruscant: "A dead metal shell of a world, Coruscant is soulless beyond salvation, so cold and empty its frozen carcass must be heated with solar mirrors."
